summary:
PLATE 0.8.5 -- Actions cost controls with one merged `pr-gates` check (breaking for adopters' required checks), `gh plate runner` and an adopter guide for self-hosted runners on private repos, empty-repo greenfield bootstrap, label sync under GitHub's 100-character limit, a complete plate-core wheel, and quieter babysit watching with a Copilot code-review skill.

## Breaking for adopters: `pr-gates` replaces the separate audit and check jobs

- The separate PR title, issue-link, documentation, feedback-resolution, audit and release-validation jobs merge into one `pr-gates` job (#1209, via #1177). This breaks any required-check list that names the old jobs. The new list is `labels`, `test` and `pr-gates`. Adopters must import `plate-pr-gates.yml`, delete the old `pr-title-check`, `pr-issue-link-check`, `pr-documentation-check`, `feedback-resolution-check` and `audit` workflows, and set required checks to `labels`, `test` and `pr-gates`. Remove the old contexts `check-pr-title`, `check-issue-links`, `feature-change-files`, `feedback-resolution`, `audit` and `validate-release-pr`. `gh plate health` reports stale names. See `docs/migration/actions-cost-rollout.md`.

## Actions and Copilot cost controls

- Issue-triggered workflows use narrow event types and job-level `if:` guards, so events that do no work don't start a runner. PR workflows cancel stacked runs. Push deploys run only on `main`. Copilot autostart is opt-in through `PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART=true` (#1150, via #1177).
- The heavy release job in `ci.yml` depends only on `test`. `validate-release-pr` moves into `pr-gates`.

## Self-hosted runners (private repos only)

- New `gh plate runner add|status|remove|doctor` plans and registers ephemeral self-hosted runners with `plate-local` plus OS labels. Settings live in `.agentic/runner.json` (#1212, via #1219).
- An adopter guide covers isolated, ephemeral runners on private repos, with explicit security warnings. `import-payload` copies it into adopting repos (#1215, via #1220). Public repos should not use self-hosted runners.

## Bootstrap and payload

- `gh plate bootstrap --greenfield --apply` works on an empty GitHub repository with no manual README commit. It avoids argv overflow on large payload uploads, leaves test media out of the payload, and adds a generic `.agentic/COSTS.md` only when one is missing. Re-running after a partial failure is safe (#1152, via #1179).
- Agents no longer get pointed at `akasper/plate_template`. New repos use `gh plate bootstrap --greenfield`, and upgrades use `import-payload` or `self-migrate` (#1151, via #1178).
- Shipped label descriptions fit GitHub's 100-character limit. Label sync truncates with a warning and keeps going after a single label fails (#1200, via #1221).
- The plate-core wheel ships the full `template_payload` tree and declares PyYAML as a runtime dependency. This fixes the incomplete 0.8.4 wheel (#1115, via #1117).

## PR babysitting and code review

- `gh plate pr babysit --watch` uses cheap REST probes (a conditional PR GET plus commit status and check runs) on quiet ticks, instead of a full GraphQL reload. Unchanged PRs no longer wake the full babysit path (#1077, via #1100).
- Wake summaries skip Copilot comments whose fingerprint was already resolved (#1096, via #1099).
- A Copilot `code-review` skill ships at `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` with the PLATE PR checklist (#1092, Epic #1091, via #1106).
- The `address-pr-feedback` skill ships in the payload. It uses `plate_get_unresolved_review_threads` (outdated threads included) for the zero-unresolved gate and resolves one thread at a time after replying (#1155, via #1180).

## Documentation

- PLATE expands to "Product Lifecycle Automation Toolkit and Engine" across shipped surfaces (#1157, via #1181).

## Adopter upgrade checklist

1. `pip install -U plate-core==0.8.5` and `gh extension upgrade gh-plate`.
2. Re-import template workflows (`gh plate import-payload`) and pull the updated `.github/labels.yml`.
3. Update required checks to `labels`, `test` and `pr-gates`, then run `gh plate health`.
4. Optional: set `PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART=true` to keep Copilot autostart.

The runner fallback and `runs-on` selection (#1214, #1222) ships in 0.8.6.

entries.migration_impact: Downstream repos should remove plate_template upstream remotes from agent docs and onboarding. Legacy plate_template forks upgrade via gh plate tooling only.
entries.agent_notes: Closes #1151. plate_template mentions in migration/cutover research docs remain intentional legacy history.
migration_guidance: 1. Do not create, clone, fork, or gh repo create --template from akasper/plate_template; start new repos per docs/bootstrap/starting-a-new-repository.md.
2. Replace git-fetch upstream template sync instructions with gh plate self-migrate and gh plate import-payload.
3. Remove template_repository: akasper/plate_template from .agentic/process.yml if present; use methodology_repository: akasper/plate.
4. PLATE_ALLOW_LEGACY_TEMPLATE_SIBLING=1 enables deprecated sibling plate_template resolution only for exceptional local dev.

entries.surface: plugin skills, template payload, AGENTS.md, pr_babysit helpers
entries.migration_impact: Bootstrapped repos receive `.agentic/skills/address-pr-feedback/SKILL.md`. Agents must use plate_get_unresolved_review_threads (or skill GraphQL fallback) for the zero-unresolved gate and plate_resolve_review_thread per thread after reply.
entries.agent_notes: Done gate counts all isResolved:false threads including outdated. Babysit --act remains a separate bulk outdated auto-resolve (#605), not a substitute for the reply+resolve loop.
migration_guidance: 1. Re-bootstrap or re-import template payload to pick up `.agentic/skills/address-pr-feedback/SKILL.md`.
2. Follow the address-pr-feedback skill: fetch/re-query with plate_get_unresolved_review_threads; resolve each thread with plate_resolve_review_thread after its in-thread reply.
3. Do not use gh plate pr babysit --act as a per-thread resolver.

entries.migration_impact: Optional: adopters with a private repo can plan and register a local runner via gh plate runner; settings are stored in .agentic/runner.json.
entries.agent_notes: Never register runners on public repositories. add and remove default to dry-run; pass --apply for live changes. Mock gh API and subprocess in tests.
migration_guidance: 1. Ensure the target repository is private; public repos are refused.
2. Run gh plate runner add OWNER/REPO (dry-run) then gh plate runner add OWNER/REPO --apply after review.
3. Use gh plate runner doctor to verify labels, token scopes, and isolation declarations.
4. Place actions-runner config.sh under .agentic/runner/ if automated configure should run on apply.

entries.migration_impact: Adopter repos should re-import template workflows; Copilot autostart is off until PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART=true.
entries.agent_notes: Issue workflows use job-level if: to skip runners on irrelevant events. plates-start-feature and plates-unblock-features omit @copilot unless PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART=true. PR workflows use concurrency with cancel-in-progress except release/publish.
migration_guidance: Run gh plate import-payload (or upgrade) and merge the .github/workflows diff.
Leave PLATE_COPILOT_AUTOSTART unset (or false) unless automatic @copilot kickoff is desired.
After #1209 lands, require pr-gates (merged gates), labels, and test; use gh plate health to find stale per-gate contexts.
Follow docs/migration/actions-cost-rollout.md for private adopter rollout order.

entries.migration_impact: Branch protection must require pr-gates instead of legacy per-gate job contexts; run gh plate health to detect stale names.
entries.agent_notes: validate-release-pr moved from ci.yml into pr-gates; heavy-release in ci.yml depends on test only. Builder: scripts/build_plate_pr_gates_workflow.py regenerates YAML from step anchors.
migration_guidance: Import plate-pr-gates.yml and delete pr-title-check, pr-issue-link-check, pr-documentation-check, feedback-resolution-check, and audit workflows.
Update required checks to labels, test, and pr-gates (see docs/migration/actions-cost-rollout.md).
Remove deprecated contexts: check-pr-title, check-issue-links, feature-change-files, feedback-resolution, audit, validate-release-pr.

entries.migration_impact: Downstream adopters on plate-core with this fix can run `gh plate bootstrap --greenfield --apply` on an empty GitHub repository without a manual README commit. Re-running apply after a partial failure is safe: identical files are skipped and remaining bootstrap steps still run. Bootstrap adds `.agentic/COSTS.md` only when missing; existing cost logs are preserved.
entries.agent_notes: GitHub contents PUT bodies use `gh api --input` JSON (never argv). Template payload excludes tests/spike-videos and large e2e GIF fixtures. Bootstrap seeds README.md when the default branch ref is missing. Payload includes a generic `.agentic/COSTS.md` header (no harvested rows); manifest `preserve_existing` skips overwrite when a cost log already exists.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / gh-plate to a build that includes this fix.
2. On empty repositories, run `gh plate bootstrap --repo OWNER/REPO --greenfield --apply` without seeding an initial commit manually.
3. If a prior apply stopped mid-way, rerun the same command; it will skip files that already match the template and complete labels, `.plate`, starter questions, and release branches.

entries.migration_impact: Pull updated `.github/labels.yml` (or run import-payload) so bootstrap label sync succeeds. Bootstrap scripts truncate over-long descriptions with a warning and report failed labels without skipping later steps.
entries.agent_notes: Use `plate_core.github_labels.GITHUB_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH` and the shipped-labels unittest when editing labels.yml. Do not rely on GitHub to accept descriptions over 100 characters.
migration_guidance: 1. Sync `.github/labels.yml` from plate-core or shorten any local label descriptions to 100 characters or fewer.
2. Re-run `scripts/bootstrap_github.sh` or `gh plate bootstrap --apply` if a prior run stopped during label sync.

entries.surface: README, AGENTS.md, SPEC.md, docs/wiki/Goals.md, .agentic/process.yml, template_payload, pyproject.toml, CLI/MCP help
entries.migration_impact: Downstream repos that spelled out the old PLATE acronym should refresh copy from template_payload or adopt Product Lifecycle Automation Toolkit and Engine in local README/AGENTS.md/process.yml when syncing.
entries.agent_notes: Use Product Lifecycle Automation Toolkit and Engine when spelling out PLATE. The acronym PLATE, package plate-core, import plate_core, and gh plate are unchanged. Historical release fragments under .agentic/releases/v* are intentionally not rewritten.

entries.migration_impact: Optional reading before registering local runners; import-payload copies the guide into adopting repos.
entries.agent_notes: Never register runners on public repos. Personal GitHub accounts need one runner registration per private repo or a free org for sharing.
migration_guidance: 1. Read docs/migration/self-hosted-runners.md before registering any self-hosted runner.
2. Keep fork and outside-contributor workflows on GitHub-hosted runs-on only.
3. Run gh plate runner for the doc path and planned CLI subcommands (#1212).

entries.migration_impact: Upgrade plate-core on the patch track; pip install plate-core pulls PyYAML and import-payload plans the full template file set.
entries.agent_notes: Wheel packaging now grafts template_payload (including .github and .agentic) via MANIFEST.in; label descriptions are capped at 100 characters for GitHub label sync.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core to the release that includes this fix.
2. Re-run gh plate bootstrap --apply or import-payload if a prior incomplete wheel left partial template files.

entries.migration_impact: No downstream repo migration. Watch mode behavior changes: unchanged PRs no longer wake the full babysit path every poll.
entries.agent_notes: gh plate pr babysit --watch probes with If-None-Match each tick, runs full babysit only on first tick, actionable wake summaries, or --full-every N. Quiet ticks print 'No change; sleeping Ns' and exponential backoff without record_wake.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core when the release containing #1077 ships.
2. Rely on wake summaries on changed ticks; use --full-every N as an optional safety net for periodic full babysit.
3. Read docs/wiki/PR-Babysit-Wake-Summary.md for watcher loop semantics.

entries.migration_impact: Downstream repos that adopt or refresh template payload receive `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` for GitHub Copilot code review on PLATE pull requests.
entries.agent_notes: Copilot code review loads skills from `.github/skills/` on the PR head branch; the `code-review` directory name improves discovery. Use the checklist for Feature/Bug/Documentation PRs: issue link, fragment location, labels, procutil subprocesses, unittest not pytest, and accurate claims.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core or re-run `gh plate import-payload` / bootstrap adopt when this release ships.
2. Ensure `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` exists on integration branches so Copilot review on PRs can load it from the head branch.
3. No `.plate` changes are required for this skill alone.

entries.migration_impact: No downstream repo migration. Watch CLI wiring to persist the resolved ledger lands in a follow-up PR.
entries.agent_notes: Repeated Copilot re-review comments matching a resolved fingerprint are suppressed (suppressed_repeats count only; not actionable alone). Persist fingerprints via ResolvedLedger under .agentic/babysit/<owner>-<repo>-<pr>.resolved.json.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core when the release containing #1096 ships.
2. When integrating PR watch wake, pass resolved fingerprints into build_wake_summary and call mark_resolved when threads are resolved.
